_comment: Frozen probe set for the skill-description A/B (grimnir).
Each probe is a natural request a user would actually make. `expect` is the skill
that should fire. The metric is read mechanically from the tool-call stream: did the
agent invoke the Skill tool with that name? That needs no judge.
trigger  - a skill SHOULD fire, and it should be `expect`.
control  - NO skill should fire. Guards against a trim that makes descriptions so
broad they capture unrelated requests. A trim that improves trigger rate
by firing on everything is a regression, and only controls catch it.
negative - a skill set adjacent to `avoid` must NOT fire. These are the destructive
skills; over-triggering them is the worst failure mode in the set.
Written BEFORE any description was edited, so the probes cannot be tuned to the trim.
Probes deliberately avoid the exact trigger vocabulary of the current descriptions —
matching a description verbatim tests string overlap, not retrieval.
